msg: The test is quite long, so do take some time before you start. I was advised to start with brown and purple, and I did, but I did not see any particular benefit. My advice is to try all colours first, then try to stick with the same two colours which give you the higher number of mushrooms. Do that until you start getting 1/2 mushrooms. Then switch colours and pick them a few times to confirm the set has switched. You'll see the mushrooms you find will start decreasing eventually. In my sets, I had the impression that purple & red tended to be often paired up together (both positively and negatively). It was not always the case though, and the pairs changed throughout the experiment.
